lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots along the lateral midline, specifically dense in the region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal spot lines to form a structured pattern across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal ridges on the upper lateral flank showing a high-contrast transition between light-reflecting dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Diffuse distribution of high-luminance points within the boundaries of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: One remora attached to the flank near the pectoral fin; visible caustic light patterns from surface refraction on the upper dorsal surface.
